order.why: Hear one divine voice through different scriptural settings.
shortened: At one time He spoke from the Divine Lote-Tree, at another in the Night Journey, and yet again from this Station, whereof every atom of its atoms beareth witness that there is none other God beside Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

order.why: Read revealed Books as the communication of bounty.
Retain the testimony of earlier heralds to this Day.
shortened: This is He Whom Adam heralded, until the matter reached the Interlocutor whom We commanded, through what We revealed in the Qur'an, to lead the people out of darkness into light and remind them of the days of God; and of Whom the Beloved informed concerning the Day when all shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.

order.why: Consider the appeal to fairness through earlier Messengers’ longing.
Connect successive Messengers with nearness and detachment.
shortened: He hath sent unto them in every age a Messenger to guide them to the court of sublime glory and to draw them nigh unto God and to detach them from all else save Him - a mercy from His presence, for He, verily, is the Most Merciful of the merciful.

order.why: Keep the final personal invitation to hear the recurring call.
shortened: O My handmaiden! Hearken with thy heart's ear unto the call of Ali in truth, then unto the call of Muhammad, then unto the call of the Spirit from the precincts of the Prison, that there is none other God but He, and that He Who hath appeared in truth is, verily, His sovereignty, His might and His grandeur unto all who dwell in the unseen and the visible realms.

order.why: Read grace as an unchained and continuing rain.
Keep the doors of guidance open.
shortened: There can be no doubt whatever that if for one moment the tide of His mercy and grace were to be withheld from the world, it would completely perish. For this reason, from the beginning that hath no beginning the portals of Divine mercy have been flung open to the face of all created things, and the clouds of Truth will continue to the end that hath no end to rain on the soil of human capacity, reality and personality their favors and bounties. Such hath been God's method continued from everlasting to everlasting.

order.why: Consider a common origin without a privileged human lineage.
Read the unending succession after Moses and Jesus.
shortened: Say: God hath raised up Messengers after Moses and Jesus, and will continue to send them until the end that hath no end, such that the outpourings of grace may never cease to rain from the heaven of divine bounty. He doeth what He willeth and is not asked of what He doeth, while all else shall be questioned concerning all things in the presence of justice.

order.why: Consider the appointed time of each luminary.
Compare continuing revelation with changing sciences, industry and needs.
shortened: Among the bounties of God is revelation. Hence revelation is progressive and continuous. It never ceases.

Therefore, the teachings of religion must be reformed and renewed because past teachings are not suitable for the present time. For example, the sciences of bygone centuries are not adequate for the present because sciences have undergone reform. The industrialism of the past will not ensure present efficiency because industrialism has advanced. The laws of the past are being superseded because they are not applicable to this time.

order.why: Keep the different modes of revelation within their source setting.
shortened: In former times the Qur'an had one station, the Gospel had one station, but in this blessed Revelation there are multiple stations - Tablets, verses, odes, sermons and prayers." Then raising His blessed hands, He said "They are abundant!"

order.why: Read the source’s distinction between days of reunion and separation.
Retain the reported sequence of Eastern places of revelation.
Connect each world’s manifestation with capacity.
shortened: In each world He appeareth according to the capacity of that world. For example, in the world of spirits He shineth upon them and appeareth unto them through spiritual effects, and likewise in the worlds of bodies, the worlds of names and attributes, and worlds which none hath known save God. Each hath a portion from this Manifestation, appearing unto them in His image to guide them unto God their Lord, draw them nigh unto the seat of His command, and bring them to what hath been ordained for them.

order.why: Consider endless journeys of creation and legislation.
shortened: The stages of creation and legislation are endless paths of the beloved's journey to the Beloved. The servants of the Most Merciful were taught again their path to God, and according to their different stations they were judged with differences - though God's religion and decree is one: "Had it been from other than God they would have found in it many discrepancies."

order.why: Preserve the reported account of unknown ages as attributed history.
Distinguish absence of records from absence of earlier humanity.
Read cycles whose records have disappeared.
Consider the continuing bounty of the Holy Spirit.
shortened: Therefore, the sound reasoning mind concludes that the bounties of the Holy Spirit are continuous and that holy souls are ever the recipients of these divine emanations. The potency of the Holy Spirit is everlasting, not temporary; for the sanctity of the Holy Spirit is its power and efficacy manifest in the spirits it quickens.
From time immemorial the divine teachings have been successively revealed, and the bounties of the Holy Spirit have ever been emanating.

order.why: Read the reported account of the Primal Will without making it a scientific claim.
shortened: The atoms of the elements are predisposed (programmed) to synthesis and composition according to the laws of nature; the Cosmic Spirit, the divine Primal Will operates and creates in this manner. The Primal Will operates in the element, in the primal atom, as attraction and repulsion; on the next higher level as organic life; then as animal-vegetative; and finally as spiritual life, which is destined to rise to the super-spiritual.

order.why: Connect eternal divine attributes with continuing manifestation.
shortened: But the power of God is eternal and the creation of God is likewise eternal. Divinity is dependent on creation. Can you imagine a king without a people? Can you imagine our sun without light and heat? The sun to us means light and heat. The king needs his kingdom and the qualities of God are eternal. As long as God exists his creation will exist and the manifestations of God in the divine teachers have always existed as an energy of God and will always continue to exist.

order.why: Distinguish material and spiritual life.
Read dawn, noon, river and sea as developmental images.
Keep the source’s reported intervals without turning them into a universal timetable.
Read earlier preparation for the Day.
Consider revelation before and after the present age.
Hear the declaration of Messengers without beginning or end.
Return to the relation between teaching and what hearers can bear.
shortened: Wherefore the dispensations of past ages are intimately connected with those that follow them: indeed, they are one and the same, but as the world groweth, so doth the light, so doth the downpour of heavenly grace, and then the Daystar shineth out in noonday splendor.

In the dispensations gone before, the feeble body of the world could not withstand a rigorous or powerful cure. For this reason did Christ say: "I have yet many things to say unto you, matters needing to be told, but ye cannot bear to hear them now.

order.why: Read the measure of disclosure while retaining the source’s ending.
Consider the image of newly disclosed letters of knowledge.
shortened: Now, concerning the recorded tradition that in former times only two letters were revealed but in the days of the Qa'im all the remaining ones shall be made manifest, the following is meant. All the works and sciences, laws and ordinances, inventions and wonders, and the perfections of the human world that had been manifested in bygone times, were even as two letters. But in this wondrous Dispensation, and with the appearance of the glorious Treasure, the perfections and attainments of the world of humanity and its limitless sciences and arts shall advance to such a degree that they may be likened unto all the remaining letters.

order.why: Keep the reported new king and new spring comparison.
Read the reported relation between a revelation and the needs it addresses.
Distinguish divine mediation from the Eternal becoming phenomenal.
Read a fuller measure of guidance in relation to receptivity.
Consider the speaker’s responsibility toward listeners’ capacity.
Read the supplied Bhagavad Gita passage on recurring restoration of duty.
Keep the supplied Gospel of Buddha passage with its specific attribution.
Read the supplied translation of the Primal Will and one sun.
shortened: ...the First Remembrance, which is the Primal Will of God, may be likened unto the sun. God hath created Him through the potency of His might, and He hath, from the beginning that hath no beginning, caused Him to be manifested in every Dispensation through the compelling power of His behest, and God will, to the end that knoweth no end, continue to manifest Him according to the good-pleasure of His invincible Purpose. And know thou that He indeed resembleth the sun. Were the risings of the sun to continue till the end that hath no end, yet there hath not been nor ever will be more than one sun....

order.why: Follow the supplied account of each revelation preparing for another.
shortened: It is clear and evident that the object of all preceding Dispensations hath been to pave the way for the advent of Muhammad, the Apostle of God. These, including the Muhammadan Dispensation, have had, in their turn, as their objective the Revelation proclaimed by the Qa'im. The purpose underlying this Revelation, as well as those that preceded it, has, in like manner, been to announce the advent of the Faith of Him Whom God will make manifest. And this Faith--the Faith of Him Whom God will make manifest--in its turn, together with all the Revelations gone before it, have as their object the Manifestation destined to succeed it. And the latter, no less than all the Revelations preceding it, prepare the way for the Revelation which is yet to follow. The process of the rise and setting of the Sun of Truth will thus indefinitely continue--a process that hath had no beginning and will have no end.

order.why: Receive the brief declaration of continuing Books and Prophets.
Keep the argument against limiting divine appearances.
Read the ongoing enlargement of divine guidance.
Read the supplied sentence about language with its given citation.
Preserve the letter’s distinction between universal purpose and followers’ response.
Read humanity’s coming of age in relation to unity.
Distinguish continuity and widening understanding from belittling earlier Prophets.
Consider complementary functions within the quoted statement.
Keep the distinction between superseding dispensations and upholding eternal truths.
Test institutions by their service to human welfare.
shortened: If long-cherished ideals and time-honored institutions, if certain social assumptions and religious formulae have ceased to promote the welfare of the generality of mankind, if they no longer minister to the needs of a continually evolving humanity, let them be swept away and relegated to the limbo of obsolescent and forgotten doctrines. Why should these, in a world subject to the immutable law of change and decay, be exempt from the deterioration that must needs overtake every human institution?... For legal standards, political and economic theories are solely designed to safeguard the interests of humanity as a whole, and not humanity to be crucified for the preservation of the integrity of any particular law or doctrine.

order.why: Reject ranking one world faith as intrinsically superior.
Retain the acknowledgment of one link in a continuing chain.
Apply the rejection of finality consistently.
Keep the explicit refusal to claim a final revelation.
Read earlier and later writings together within the Báb’s ministry.
Close with gradual revelation and implementation within a single ministry.

questions: How do the images of a child, a physician, and recurring spring illuminate different aspects of progressive revelation? Where might each image have limits?
How can continuity of spiritual purpose coexist with changes in religious laws and institutions? Which readings help you examine that distinction?
What might turn love for an earlier revelation into openness to further learning—or into resistance? How could a seeker recognize this tension in themselves?
How do the passages connect humanity’s growing capacities with the responsibility to build unity? What kinds of growth require patient cultivation?
What do the comparative Gospel passages suggest about readiness and changing forms? How does their immediate setting shape the comparison?
How might refusing a claim of finality affect religious humility, present commitment, and inquiry into future revelation?

references.label: 1 · John 16:12–15 · Readiness and further guidance
references.note: Jesus tells his disciples that they cannot yet bear all he has to say and speaks of the guidance of the Spirit of truth. Compare the relation between readiness and disclosure with the compilation’s images of education. Read the promise within John’s account while exploring how these passages interpret continuity and further guidance.

references.label: 2 · Mark 2:18–22 · Fasting, new cloth, and new wine
references.note: A question about fasting leads Jesus to speak of the bridegroom, a patch of new cloth, and new wine in old containers. Consider how the immediate question gives these images their force. Compare their treatment of changing conditions with the compilation’s accounts of laws, renewal, and the forms that can sustain new life.

subjects.displayTitle: Receiving and reflecting light: the Manifestation as sun
subjects.introduction: On a bright morning the sun gives light and warmth to everything beneath it without asking what it is. ‘Abdu’l-Bahá begins there, with the plain experience of a sunny day, and lets it open onto the Sun of Truth whose rays educate souls as sunlight draws out seeds. The light is the light, whichever lamp it shines from, and the sun of today may truly call itself the sun of yesterday; so the Messengers of God are one radiance from different horizons, and the trouble begins when love for a particular lamp makes a new dawn invisible. The same light shows differently in a polished mirror and a dull stone, which turns attention to the heart that receives it and to the clouds of prejudice and desire that veil it. The sun does not set when it seems to; the earth turns. The Qur’an’s niche and lamp and Jesus’ word that he is the light of the world say this in neighbouring ways. From here educator, physician and gardener describe what the light does, the mirror asks how it is received, and the question comes home: whether one has become a lighted taper or merely bears a name.
subjects.arc: Open with light recognized beyond its container and embodied through conduct; explore life, education and the limits of analogy; consider one sun through many horizons and mirrors; examine veils, recognition and continuing illumination; read the personal and devotional addresses; return to service and reflection of the light.

order.why: Open with recognition beyond the lamp, garden or direction.
shortened: The light is the light, no matter from what lamp it shines. The rose is the rose, no matter from which rose-garden it comes. The fruit is the fruit, no matter upon which tree it is produced. The breeze possesses life, no matter from which direction it is wafted.

order.why: Make illumination a question of embodied conduct.
shortened: Strive then to the best of thine ability to let these children know that a Baha'i is one who embodieth all the perfections, that he must shine out like a lighted taper -- not be darkness upon darkness and yet bear the name "Baha'i".

order.why: Introduce grace reaching the whole world.
Connect spiritual sunlight with new life in hearts and minds.
shortened: In like manner, the holy Manifestations of God are the focal Centres of the light of truth, the Wellsprings of the hidden mysteries, and the Source of the effusions of divine love. They cast Their effulgence upon the realm of hearts and minds and bestow grace everlasting upon the world of the spirits. They confer spiritual life and shine with the splendour of inner truths and meanings.

In like manner, when the holy Manifestation of God, Who is the Sun of the world of creation, casts His splendour upon the world of hearts, minds, and spirits, a spiritual springtime is ushered in and a new life is unveiled.

order.why: Start from the familiar warmth of a sunny day.
Explore illumination as moral and spiritual education.
shortened: In brief, the moral and ethical world and the world of spiritual regeneration are dependent for their progressive being upon that heavenly Center of illumination. It gives forth the light of religion and bestows the life of the spirit, imbues humanity with archetypal virtues and confers eternal splendors. This Sun of Reality, this Center of effulgences, is the Prophet or Manifestation of God.

order.why: Read the reported comparison between growth and education.
Consider encouragement as an effect of spiritual light.
Read the reported relation between Manifestations and human progress.
shortened: The centers of progress for each age are the manifestations of God as seen in his prophets. In whatever country or at whatever time they appear, they are the focus of the creational day - for as the sun in the material heaven develops the material beings, so do these spiritual suns develop the world of minds and souls.

order.why: Connect the sun with the cultivation of ideal principles.
Consider transformation from barrenness into fruitful life.
shortened: The true light is the ray of the Sun of Reality which leads the human world from the abyss of imperfection to the highest summit of perfection, bestows the spirit of life upon the lifeless and barren earth, and adorns it with various flowers and fragrances.

order.why: Read Christ’s illumination through unity, love and spiritual life.
Identify the moral qualities called light in the reported explanation.
shortened: Verses 12-20: There is a great difference between God and all creatures.  All the creation is in darkness but God is the Light.  Jesus says, "I am the Light of the world; he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness but shall have the Light of Life."  The Light here spoken of means the Light of His Perfections - justice, mercy, goodness, love, holiness, truth, unworldliness, righteousness, purity, etc.

order.why: Connect recognition of Christ with divine perfections.
shortened: Now, the sun is the sun by virtue of its effulgent rays; without these rays it would not be the sun. If the perfections of God were not revealed and manifested in Jesus, He would not be Christ. He is a Manifestation of God precisely because the divine perfections are revealed in Him.

order.why: Read the reported knowledge of God through qualities.
shortened: "As we know the physical sun by its splendor, by its light and heat so we know God, by the spiritual sun, when he shines forth from the temple of Manifestation by his attributes of perfection, by the beauty of his qualities and by the splendor of his light.

order.why: Distinguish material light from the education of spiritual realities.
Name the outer sun as a symbol of the Word.
Notice the source’s explicit use of allusion and symbol.
Explore the limits of the sun image before the divine station.
shortened: In truth, the mention of the Sun and its like refers to His exalted and sublime station among the servants, otherwise every person of insight beareth witness to the sanctification of His Essence from whatsoever hath been mentioned and the detachment of His Self from whatsoever hath been or shall be comprehended. And that this Most Great Manifestation hath been or may be designated as the heaven is due to the fact that the sun, outwardly speaking, appeareth and becometh visible from the horizon of this expanse which is called heaven, and the heaven dominateth and encompasseth it, as can be observed.

order.why: Keep the reported limit on comprehending the Sun of Reality.
shortened: To comprehend the Sun of Reality we would have to be greater (than the Sun). In order to comprehend the Essence of God a Prophet would have to encompass the Infinite.
The lower can never comprehend the higher, but the higher can comprehend the lower.

order.why: Read the warning against imagining the sun entering every object.
Examine the Iqan’s multiple meanings of sun and its account of unity and distinction.
shortened: Consider the sun. Were it to say now, "I am the sun of yesterday," it would speak the truth. And should it, bearing the sequence of time in mind, claim to be other than that sun, it still would speak the truth.

By the terms "sun" and "moon," mentioned in the writings of the Prophets of God, is not meant solely the sun and moon of the visible universe. Nay rather, manifold are the meanings they have intended for these terms. In every instance they have attached to them a particular significance. Thus, by the "sun" in one sense is meant those Suns of Truth Who rise from the dayspring of ancient glory, and fill the world with a liberal effusion of grace from on high. These Suns of Truth are the universal Manifestations of God in the worlds of His attributes and names.

order.why: Read different dawning points with one sun.
shortened: For instance, the sun is one and the same, but its points of dawning are various. During the summer season it rises from the northern point of the ecliptic; in winter it appears from the southern point of rising. Each month between, it appears from a certain zodiacal position. Although these dawning points are different, the sun is the same sun which has appeared from them all. The significance is the reality of Prophethood which is symbolized by the sun, and the holy Manifestations are the dawning places or zodiacal points.

order.why: Connect the image with the unity of prophetic messages.
Consider the particular effects attributed to different stations.
Read the prayer’s rejection of division among the Messengers.
shortened: I testify, O Thou Who art the Lord of the whole creation, and the Desire of whosoever hath sought Thee, that, amidst Thy creatures, They resemble the sun which no matter how often it riseth and setteth is still the one and the same sun. Whoso maketh any distinction between any of Them hath truly failed to attain the ultimate purpose, and to reach the highest goal, and hath been deprived of the mysteries of unity and of the lights of sanctity and oneness.

order.why: Keep the reported relation between historical activity and common nature.
shortened: The Prophets and Their religions are to be compared to the sun which rises on different days and at different times - but always as the same, identical in Their nature, differing only as to Their place in history and Their activity -, Who educate mankind as the teacher educates the child.

order.why: Read the Báb’s recurring sun in its concise form.
shortened: And thou must bear witness that His likeness is as the sun in the heavens - though it may rise countless times, it is but one sun, and likewise when it setteth.

order.why: Consider the Arabic Bayan’s sun as a token of dispensations.
shortened: Verily, the sun is but a token from My presence so that the true believers among My servants may discern in its rising the dawning of every Dispensation.

order.why: Connect spiritual cycles with perpetual renewal.
Read the reported identification of prophetic appearance with spring.
Keep the reported unending rising and setting.
Preserve the brief reported comparison of changing points.
Read Christ and Bahá’u’lláh within the source’s solar image.
Retain the reported statement of manifested qualities.
Apply recognition of the light consistently across lamps.
Examine attachment to lamps in the extended reported example.
Consider the limits of looking only toward a former horizon.
Read openness to an unfamiliar dawning point as spiritual progress.
Keep the reported affirmation of the truth of religions.
Distinguish sun, rays and the Holy Spirit in the analogy.
shortened: The Divine Reality may be likened to the sun and the Holy Spirit to the rays of the sun. As the rays of the sun bring the light and warmth of the sun to the earth, giving life to all created beings, so do the 'Manifestations' bring the power of the Holy Spirit from the Divine Sun of Reality to give light and life to the souls of men.

order.why: Read the illumination of all levels of creation.
shortened: But in the eyes of the people of Truth, the Baha'is, that unseen and unknowable Being is like unto the sun, which hath dawned above all things and from whose rays all creatures, whether mineral, plant, animal, or human, obtain illumination. That is to say, its effulgent rays shine upon them all and they, in turn, reflect faithfully its light.

order.why: Consider the distinction between producing and acquiring light.
shortened: For instance, the constituent parts of the sun can in no wise be compared to those of the moon. The composition and arrangement of the former necessarily produce rays, whereas the constituent parts of the latter require the acquisition, rather than the production, of light. So the other human realities are souls, which, like the moon, acquire their light from the sun, but that sanctified Reality is luminous in and of itself.

order.why: Explore borrowed perfections and differing capacities.
Read the Báb’s independent sun and receptive mirrors.
shortened: He -- glorified be His mention -- resembleth the sun. Were unnumbered mirrors to be placed before it, each would, according to its capacity, reflect the splendor of that sun, and were none to be placed before it, it would still continue to rise and set, and the mirrors alone would be veiled from its light.

order.why: Keep the prayer’s single Point and many mirrors.
Read return at the level of the mirror’s reflection.
Preserve the Báb’s account of return within its symbolic vocabulary.
shortened: Thou seest that his body returneth unto clay, his essential body returneth unto the Gates, his essential soul returneth unto the Imams, his essential spirit returneth unto the Prophet, and his essential heart returneth unto the Manifestation of Glorification, which is intended to be the Sun of Truth.

order.why: Keep the concise statement about the return of rays.
shortened: The rays return, for it is the Sun, and the ultimate ascent is this luminous station.

order.why: Distinguish universal Manifestations from other prophetic roles.
shortened: Another kind of Prophets are followers and promulgators, not leaders and law-givers, but they are nonetheless the recipients of the hidden inspirations of God. Yet another kind are Prophets Whose prophethood has been limited to a particular locality. But the universal Manifestations are all-encompassing: They are like the root, and all others are as the branches; they are like the sun, and all others are as the moon and the stars.

order.why: Read the distinctions between divine and heavenly spirit.
shortened: The divine spirit which is from God's command refers to the holy power, divine confirmations, eternal assistance, divine knowledge and heavenly sciences with which God aids whomever He wishes among His righteous servants.

The heavenly spirit is a holy essence, a perfect word, a complete sign, the mystery of existence and the reality hidden from the eyes of all beings. It is the Supreme Pen, the Divine Soul, and the manifestation of Truth from the dawning-place of creation and its sun at the dayspring of invention. This is specific to the Prophets in the worlds of creation.

order.why: Keep the source’s transition from mathematical discussion to spiritual imagery.
Distinguish essential constancy from worldly appearance and concealment.
Read the Daystar as always manifest in its Kingdom.
Consider the reported distinction between apparent motion and enduring light.
shortened: The material sun is stationary, but to the eyes it appears to rise and set, because of the revolution of the earth. The Spiritual Sun is purified and sanctified above rising and setting, but because the contingent beings appear and disappear, it also seems to do the same. Although, It, like the material Sun, is stationary and is ever shining.

order.why: Read rising and setting in relation to creation.
Keep the reported account of horizons as relational.
Read changing appearance beside a constant spiritual force.
Consider the sun’s independence of the receiving earth.
Keep the reported contrast between earthly growth and solar self-sufficiency.
shortened: The sun is the light and life of the world. The intention of the sun is to illumine the earth, and the function of the earth is to produce growth in the different kingdoms, vegetable, animal, human, and so on. Everything of earth may have growth because it is the quality (lit.-requirement) of the sun that it should. All this is the effect of the sun upon the body of the earth. The sun in his station is self-sufficient and does not need growth. There is no rising or setting for the sun, because there is no movement to it in its station.

order.why: Read the sun and earth analogy as an account of dependence.
shortened: The Divine Reality is to man what the sun is to earth. The sun is life, radiance, heat, energy, power. The earth is dead, inert, helpless, incapable of initiative or change. It is poor, cold, and without resources.

order.why: Retain the reported explanation of light sustaining all things.
Consider visibility through illumination in the atom image.
shortened: Although the atom has no existence by itself, yet under the effulgence of the Sun it becomes apparent.

order.why: Examine the relation between accepting the sun and accepting its rays.
shortened: Is it possible to accept the sun and to reject its rays? He who rejects the rays is a rejector of the sun, too.
They do not know that the divine Manifestations are the bright rays of the Sun of Truth and a means of educating the realities of man.

order.why: Keep the short reported image of making a sun with oil and wick.
Distinguish a limited lamp from the power to unite peoples.
Read the reported electric bulb comparison with its source omission.
shortened: For example this electric bulb is a center of light but it only illumines the room but the Sun shines upon all the created phenomena without any distinction ...

order.why: Consider differing ranges of illumination in the reported sequence.
Read the invitation to seek continuous light.
Keep the reported bounty shared by sovereign and citizen.
shortened: But the Heavenly Sovereignty is like the Sun when all the satellites of the Solar System revolve around it.  To all of them the Sun gives light, and is eternal.  Both the sovereign and the citizen receive bounty.

order.why: Consider sunlight reaching all phenomena.
Retain the reported declaration of light everywhere.
shortened: "Where, where, is the Sun of Truth?"
"The Sun of Truth is everywhere. It is shining on the whole world."

order.why: Examine increasing perception as clouds disperse.
shortened: O friends of Truth! It is the afternoon time and the sun's rays are diminishing, but the Sun of Reality is shining and gleaming from the unseen Kingdom with an ever-increasing and multiplying world-illumining radiance. Although for its shining there is no increase or decrease, yet as the intervening clouds and dense vapors increasingly dissipate, the radiance of the Sun of Reality becomes greater and the effulgence of the Luminary of the horizons becomes more magnificent.

order.why: Read the reported obstruction of light by clouds.
shortened: The Kingdom of God is like unto the sun. It sends the rays on all things. This globe of earth is illuminated by it. In every country where there is no cloud the sun reflects and where there is a cloud all of the sun of the country is concealed.

order.why: Name idle fancies as clouds within the image.
Consider prejudice as an obstruction to illumination.
shortened: Fix your eyes on the Sun of Truth for his light floods the whole earth. Let the sun give you of his strength then the clouds of prejudice will not hide his light from your eyes, then will the sun be without clouds for you.

order.why: Read measured manifestation in relation to self and passion.
Compare a polished mirror and an unreflective surface.
Keep the reported parallel comparison of stone and mirror.
Look toward hearts becoming clearer mirrors over time.
Read the association of a pure heart with immediate illumination.
Consider spiritual perception within the source’s sight image.
Keep the source’s account of being veiled through lack of insight.
Read evident light alongside unresponsive hearts.
Preserve the source’s reported denial of daylight.
shortened: And when the brilliant Sun arose, they crept into the corners of their doubts and the crypts of their various delusions, saying "This is night, not day; darkness, not heart-ravishing light.

order.why: Examine attachment to fancies when revelation appears.
shortened: But when the Sun of Truth dawned from the horizon of manifestation and the Preserved Tablet was sent down from the heaven of loving-kindness, all clung to their own idle fancies and turned away from the Sovereign of certitude, save those who came unto God with an illumined, believing, and steadfast heart.

order.why: Consider sweetness of the Word as a means of recognition.
shortened: Yet when the Sun of Revelation appeared manifest and evident from the horizon of light, all remained veiled save those souls who perceived the sweetness of the divine Word.

order.why: Keep the contrast between appearance and few recognizing it.
shortened: Yet when the Sun of Revelation dawned from the horizon of the world, and the Speaker of Sinai spoke forth, all were found to be veiled save a few.

order.why: Read abundant bounty alongside deprivation.
shortened: The Sun of Truth has appeared with perfect manifestation and effulgence, and the ocean of bounty is surging. Nevertheless, all remain deprived and veiled save those whom God, thy Lord, has willed.

order.why: Examine reliance upon a leader’s denial.
Read the source’s image of opposition at unveiling.
Follow its account of veils drawn and overcome.
shortened: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of God!
When the Most Great Luminary shed its splendor from the horizons of the nations, the dark realities that were enemies of light drew veils over their eyes and crept into the abyss of decline and fall.

The Sun of Truth with one ray rent asunder and destroyed all those veils and shrouds, and shone so brilliantly at the meridian of the heavens that the contingent world became illumined with the lights of the realm of the unconstrained, and the dark dwelling of the horizons became resplendent with the effulgence of the Supreme Horizon.

order.why: Examine imitation in the account of hearts becoming mirrors.
shortened: Verily that light (i.e., the Light of the Manifestation) shone forth from the horizon of the Manifestation, appeared upon the horizon of existence, and the darkness was changed into light; the Sun of Guidance dawned in the horizon of heaven, whereby the eyes which were looking unto the Kingdom of God were illuminated, the breasts which were filled with God's love were dilated, and the heavenly spirits were attracted by the magnet of the Holy Spirit, so that the hearts became as pure mirrors reflecting the godlike appearances and manifesting the heavenly lights--except the eyes which were in the veil of imitation of the forefathers (i.e., those who followed the theories of their fathers) were hindered from or veiled from witnessing that brilliant and godlike illumination, and the people held to the superstitions of the Pharisees and neglected the mystery of God and the glad-tidings (recorded) in the Holy Scriptures, which elucidated the appearance of the Lord of Hosts in the promised day.

order.why: Keep the personal address about earthly attachment.
shortened: O daughter of the Kingdom! When the Sun of Truth dawned from the horizon of Iran, every soul that belonged to the world of nature - that is, whose element of existence was purely earthly - remained completely veiled and deprived.

order.why: Retain the paired images of turning from sun and tree.
Read the bat image as part of the source’s response to refusal.
shortened: But alas, a hundred thousand regrets that when that Sun rose with the light of manifestation, the bat-like people crept into the corner of darkness and ran into underground caves, not seeing His evident lights.

order.why: Consider the reported preference for dark rooms and candles.
shortened: The Sun of Reality is in the height of its power and majesty but they prefer dark rooms and the light of the candles.

order.why: Examine the reversal from longing to failure of recognition.
shortened: While the Sun was concealed behind the clouds, all were engaged in lamentation and weeping, yet when it emerged through the blessing of the Most Great Name from behind the clouds, most failed to behold it, for eyes were afflicted with the ophthalmia of desire.

order.why: Read waiting followed by opposition.
Consider physical proximity without recognition or response.
shortened: This is Our remembrance for him who consorted with his Lord yet knew Him not, who heard the call of God yet answered it not, and upon whom in every moment there shone forth the Sun of Beauty from the horizon of glory, yet he recounted not its effulgences.

order.why: Read the source’s argument against making earlier writings a barrier.
Keep the stated consequences of hesitation within the source’s address.
Read the source’s forceful solar and bat imagery in context.
shortened: The Sun [of Glory] hath dawned from the horizon of eternity with the ornament of God, the Almighty, the Most High, the Most Exalted.
By God, O bat, the day of thy death hath come, for the Sun of Beauty hath risen at the meridian with the sovereignty of grandeur and majesty.

order.why: Keep the appeal not to deny after illumination.
shortened: Deny not the Sun after its light hath illumined all who dwell in the kingdom of Command and Creation and those who abide behind the ocean of grandeur in an exalted and holy station.

order.why: Read the invitation through eyes, ears and heart.
shortened: Say: O people, deny not God and His signs, now that the Sun of Beauty hath dawned from the horizon of majesty and standeth at the meridian with sovereign independence, and uttereth at every moment the sweetest melodies, saying: O peoples of the earth, deprive not yourselves of His beauty, nor your eyes from gazing upon His countenance, nor your ears from hearkening unto His verses, nor your hearts from recognizing My Self, the Mighty, the Beloved.

order.why: Retain the warning in relation to the source of sun and moon.
shortened: Beware lest ye deny Him through Whom the sun hath shone forth and the moon hath appeared in this heaven which hath been raised up through this Great Name.

order.why: Consider the invitation not to deprive oneself.
Read dependence upon light alongside the obstruction of desires.
Turn the image of veils into a prayer for removal.
shortened: Beseech ye God that He may, with the finger of His power, rend asunder the veils that have hindered men, and withhold them not from beholding the lights of the Sun of Revelation.

order.why: Read the prayer for strengthened sight.
Receive the invitation to lift one’s head and open one’s eyes.
shortened: Lift up your heads and open your eyes, that ye may behold the Sun of the Beauty of your Lord shining forth from the horizon of destiny with the sovereignty of His Most Glorious and Most Sublime Remembrance.

order.why: Keep the brief call at the sun’s zenith.
shortened: Open your eyes - verily the Sun is at its zenith. Hold fast unto it and be not of the wrongdoers.

order.why: Return to the invitation to behold the meridian sun.
Read the appeal to look toward proof.
shortened: Say: Look ye, look ye, for the Sun hath risen from the horizon of proof.

order.why: Hear the direct invitation to turn toward the Sun.
Explore nurturing radiance through appearance and concealment.
Distinguish departure from this world from continued radiance.
Read the deprivation of visible presence.
Preserve the reaction to the setting of the visible light.
Examine the mistaken expectation that departure ends illumination.
shortened: O Servant of God! Some of the heedless ones have imagined that since the Sun of Truth has set from the horizon of the human temple, its holy rays have also declined, meaning that the realm of possibility has become the longest night and darkness has been established upon the throne.

order.why: Read the related supposition that the fire has been extinguished.
Seek guidance beyond the Day of Meeting.
Read the prayer for radiant faces after the visible setting.
Connect grief with remembrance of the martyrs.
shortened: During times of misfortune and hardship, one should take consolation through the memory of the martyrs, for the fruit of this world shall ever be loss and regret, especially after the setting of the Sun of Existence and the Most Great Luminary of the placeless.

order.why: Preserve the source’s comparison of a ray and a drop.
shortened: When the Most Luminous Sun hath set, if a ray ascendeth it hath no effect, and when the Most Great Ocean disappeareth, the separation of a drop createth no commotion.

order.why: Read tribulation beside the eclipse image.
shortened: When such an eclipse and waning befalls the radiant Sun and shining Moon, what care need we destitute ones have of tribulation?

order.why: Keep the consolation concerning the suffering of the Luminary.
shortened: O loved ones of God! Do not grieve over what hath befallen the Luminary of the horizons. Verily, the sun is eclipsed and the moon is darkened.

order.why: Retain the lament for a vanished sun in its source setting.
shortened: By God! Were ye to perceive within yourselves, ye would weep with the weeping of the bereaved for this Sun that hath vanished from you, which had been illumined with the light of God.

order.why: Distinguish the physical sunset from spiritual dawn.
shortened: That orb is setting while this Light is rising. That one causes the mixing, blending, growth and development of bodies, while this one causes the enkindlement, attraction, joy and delight of spirits. That one is setting while this one is dawning; that one is fading while this one is flashing.

order.why: Read the prayer to worship a Sun that never sets.
Consider darkness unable to endure growing radiance.
shortened: Despite this, the veil has so obscured vision that among the people of the world only a few are enlightened while all the rest remain captive to the darkness of the furnace. However, the rays of the Sun of Truth have become so brilliant that this darkness cannot endure. Soon you will see that in this new age and wondrous century, the gleaming light of the morn of guidance will illuminate distant horizons.

order.why: Keep the reported sense of being only at the dawn.
shortened: "Now is only the emergence of the dawn of the Sun of Truth," His blessed Person told us. "Soon it will envelop the whole earth."

order.why: Read the Báb’s address combining sun, moon and mortal imagery.
Consider the Temple of Unity as the Day-Spring of the invisible Sun.
Read sun, ocean and heaven as successive images.
shortened: Say: By God! At times I behold Him as the sun in the temple of holiness, and at times I witness that He surgeth within His Own Self, by His Own Self, for His Own Self, like the ocean that encompasseth all worlds. At times I behold that He hath risen like the heaven, and all created things dwell beneath His shadow, nay, beneath the shadow of His shadow, inhabited in justice. At times He appeareth with light, then radiance, then effulgence, then manifestation and gleaming that seizeth the eyes of all who are in the heavens and earth from turning to His countenance or gazing upon His beauty.

order.why: Explore the Word through human form, light, tree and sun.
Read the linked human, heavenly and concealed stations.
Preserve the interpretive account of the human temple and setting sun.
shortened: When the divine Dhu'l-Qarnayn traversed the East and West of existence and unveiled the horizon of the unseen and the visible, He saw the Sun of Truth rising and setting in the dawning-place of lights of the human temple and elemental frame, "He found it setting in a murky spring."

order.why: Consider signs in the horizons and within souls.
shortened: This Luminous Light and Merciful Star and Divine Full Moon and Sun that has no equal has a rising and shining forth from the horizon of horizons, and a dawning and appearance from the horizon of souls, as God the Exalted has said: "We shall show them Our signs in the horizons and in themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the Truth."

order.why: Read the source’s use of the Qur’anic lamp, glass and niche.
Connect illumination with Moses’ search for guidance.
Hear the Herald’s announcement before the Speaker of Sinai.
Read the summons of the Speaker of Sinai to the Supreme Horizon.
Keep the account of earlier prophetic announcements.
shortened: Today the Sun of Truth is His dawning - that Announcement wherewith all the Prophets gave glad tidings to the servants, and wherewith the divine Books, Scrolls and Psalms were adorned and embellished.

order.why: Examine the source’s interpretation of the Seal and the Day of God.
shortened: Thus doth the Dawning-Place of the verses of God, the Lord of the Day of Resurrection, command thee. In this day the Sun of Truth, from the horizon of the prison of 'Akka, speaketh this most sublime Word: I say in truth, the blessed word "but He is the Apostle of God and the Seal of the Prophets" found its consummation in "the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds."

order.why: Retain the voices of fire and light at Sinai.
Read the scriptural celestial imagery in the source’s proclamation.
Preserve the devotional movement through Sinai and reunion.
shortened: The Cup-Bearer of 'Ama offers the goblet of the wine of faithfulness with radiant light, that ye may become enraptured in the Sinai of love through the manifestation of Beauty, and after attaining unto "when he recovered from his swoon," ye may hear from the tongue of the heart the blessed verse "And to God belongeth the Kingdom of the heavens and of the earth," that ye may enter, intoxicated, into the gathering of love and the assembly of affection and become thankful.

order.why: Explore Joseph’s beauty as an image of illumination.
shortened: O ye intoxicated lovers of the countenance of the Beloved Friend! When the Beauteous Beloved revealed Himself among souls in the form of a precious human being, the light shining from this Joseph illumined the whole world with its beauty and the lamp of reunion was lit in Egypt of the spirit.

order.why: Read the parallel Joseph image with exact source wording.
Read the Candle consuming mortal veils.
shortened: The everlasting Candle shineth in its naked glory. Behold how it hath consumed every mortal veil.

order.why: Consider revelation from imprisonment.
Keep the Prison as the setting of radiance.
shortened: The Sun of Baha hath shone forth from the horizon of eternity in this Prison which God hath illumined with His presence.

order.why: Read the appearance of light after rejection.
shortened: In the darkness of the earth, after the turning away of souls, He was witnessed like the sun from the horizon of the spirit in the holy dawning-place of truth.

order.why: Consider the sun illuminating regions and faces.
Retain the declaration of present radiance.
shortened: Today the Sun of Manifestation is shining and the light of His countenance is radiant.

order.why: Read the blessing upon turning toward the light.
Keep the announcement of divine appearance and sovereignty.
Hear the sun as a herald of glad tidings.
shortened: Verily the sun proclaimeth and beareth glad-tidings to the sincere of what hath been ordained for them in a perspicuous Book.

order.why: Retain the personal address joining revelation and the Pen.
shortened: O Ibrahim! The Sun of Revelation hath appeared and is visible from the horizon of the heaven of divine knowledge, and the Most Exalted Pen is occupied with the praise of the friends of God in this glorious station.

order.why: Read hidden meanings appearing as a spiritual sun.
Consider inner meanings as nourishment for realities.
shortened: Verily they are the Sun of inner meanings, and by them are nourished the realities of all things, would ye but understand.

order.why: Read the image of suns shining from eternity.
Join utterance, proof and certitude in the source’s images.
Consider the proclamation of a lifted veil.
shortened: Say: O people, do ye not witness how the sun hath risen and the light hath shone forth and the veil hath been rent asunder and God hath stood forth in the holy concourse while the Dove announceth before Him with such melody that all in the kingdom are stunned thereby?

order.why: Read shelter beneath the Youth and the rising of suns.
shortened: Follow thou God's religion and His way, then seek shelter beneath the shade of this Youth Who, when He appeareth from the horizon of the House, causeth suns to rise from the horizon of the worlds of the unseen and the seen, shining from a station truly exalted.

order.why: Keep the call to behold the Most Glorious Horizon.
shortened: Say: O peoples of the earth! Behold how the Sun hath dawned from the Most Glorious Horizon and the Light hath shone forth from this noble station.

order.why: Retain the image of the sun at its zenith.
shortened: Say: Verily He hath shone forth from the horizon of glory like the sun at its zenith.

order.why: Read the Day of God in relation to lesser lights.
shortened: Say: The Sun hath risen and the Day of God hath appeared, effacing thereby the light of the stars, if ye be possessed of insight.

order.why: Consider the cleansing of the tablets of hearts.
Preserve the relation between sun, shadow, tree and fruit.
shortened: For the shadow has ever been with the sun and moves around it, and the fruit has ever been with the ultimate tree - at times manifest and at times hidden.

order.why: Read grace encompassing the world.
shortened: Today the Kingdom of God is illumined by the lights of the Sun of Manifestation, and the radiance of the Sun of Grace hath encompassed the world.

order.why: Connect the Pen with the Sun of Knowledge.
shortened: The earth hath been illumined by the lights of the Countenance and the heaven hath been adorned with the stars of wisdom and utterance, yet the people behold not. Thus hath the Sun of Knowledge shone forth from the horizon of the Pen of thy Lord, the Merciful.

order.why: Consider the Written and Preserved Tablet in one station.
Keep the paired illumination of faces and horizons.
Read verses as the horizon of the Sun’s appearance.
shortened: Glorified is He Who sends down verses at all times, and through them the Sun has shone forth from a holy and exalted horizon.

order.why: Retain the declaration of heaven and earth illumined.
shortened: Say: O people! By God, the Most Great Luminary hath appeared and through Him the heavens and earth have been illumined.

order.why: Explore the joined images of utterance, sea and sun.
shortened: The remembrance of God, in the form of the Sun behind the ocean of grandeur, hath been witnessed above the horizon of utterance.
The Most Great Ocean hath appeared, and upon it hath moved the Sun of Beauty with a light that hath encompassed all worlds.

order.why: Read the testimony to the Sun risen through the divine name.
shortened: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, and that He Who hath appeared is verily the Sun risen from the horizon of this heaven which hath been upraised in truth through His name, the Mighty, the Inaccessible.

order.why: Keep the personal notice of a dawning and departure.
shortened: O my handmaid, upon thee be My glory! Today the Sun of Truth has risen from the horizon of the heaven of grandeur, and the Lord of mankind has departed for another land.

order.why: Preserve the blessing from the Dayspring of the Cause.
shortened: And upon thee be the glory from this Glory which hath shone forth from the Dayspring of the Cause with brilliant lights.

order.why: Hear the joined appearance of the divine Name and Tree.
shortened: Praise be to God that the realm of existence hath been illumined and brightened by the Sun of the Divine Name, and the Call of the Divine Tree hath been raised.

order.why: Read the Sun alongside the billowing Ocean of bounty.
Retain the concise testimony to divine beauty.
Consider continual utterance and ever-dawning beauty.
shortened: The voice of the Most Exalted Pen is raised at all times, and the tongue of Grandeur speaks forth in every moment, and the Sun of the Beauty of the Beloved is ever-dawning from the horizon of glory.

order.why: Read the Sun and the rustling Tree in a personal address.
shortened: O My handmaiden! Today the Sun of Manifestation hath risen and is shining from the horizon of the heaven of God's Command, and the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree is raised before the faces of humanity.

order.why: Keep the declaration of an illumined world.
Retain the promise of the Sun of eternity.
Read guidance through niche, glass and horizon.
Consider the all-embracing Word sustaining luminosity.
shortened: Today that all-embracing Word is the Cause of the Ancient Beauty, which encompasses the world of creation and by whose radiance, manifestation and appearance the luminosity of existence is sustained.

order.why: Keep the proclamation addressed to those guided by light.
shortened: O ye who are guided by the light of guidance!
The lamp of guidance is aflame and the supreme horizon is radiant and resplendent with the light of the Most Glorious Beauty, shining forth upon the horizons of nations.

order.why: Read the spread of the call from Sinai.
shortened: The call of the Manifestation of the Lord of Sinai has caused tumult in all regions, and the fame of the greatness of the Sun of Truth has spread throughout the horizons.

order.why: Retain the short statement of an Eastern dawning.
Consider limitless light from the horizon of oneness.
Read East and West transformed through the solar image.
Examine dependence upon grace amid the passing of human structures.
Keep the source’s accumulation of names for guidance.
Read the poetic comparison with gardens of Paradise.
shortened: Through the grace of that world-illumining Sun's rays, the universe became the envy of the gardens of Paradise, and through the light of that Sun of Reality's manifestation, the horizons became the object of the Ridvan Garden's jealousy.

order.why: Preserve the personal address to a spiritual star.
Consider revelation uncovering the realities of things.
Read the cosmic movement attributed to a new dawn.
Keep the relation between a heard melody and dispersed darkness.
shortened: When that melody and song reaches the ears of the people of mystery in the monasteries of the Kingdom, that clime will be stirred into motion and the morn of guidance will shine so brightly that the darkness of error will be utterly dispersed and matters will be set right.

order.why: Retain the candle kindled within humanity.
shortened: O faithful servant! That Manifest Light, like unto a shining candle, was set ablaze in the assemblage of man. The moths of the flower-garden of the Merciful circled round that Incandescent Lamp, and they feared no one save God.

order.why: Read the Lamp of Guidance shining upon all horizons.
shortened: O namesake of His Holiness the Exalted One! Since thou hast been named with this blessed name, thou must seek a portion and share of His grace and, like a moth, burn thy wings and pinions circling round the luminous candle of the Concourse on High.
That Lamp of Guidance is the Abha Beauty, Who shineth resplendent in the Concourse on High upon all horizons.

order.why: Examine awareness of effects without knowledge of their source.
shortened: They acknowledge the supreme movement of existence and minds, and observe the intense power of the mystery of being, yet they know not and are heedless of the center of this great outpouring, unaware that although the lights of mysteries have illumined the horizons, the center of light is the Sun of Truth which has shone forth and radiated from the Kingdom of mysteries.

order.why: Preserve the particular news from Mazandaran.
Read the expectation of unveiling in its source setting.
shortened: O pure friends of God! All the vast multitudes of the world are watching and waiting to see that King remove His veil and that enchanting Face reveal itself like the sun and moon, and to catch the musk-scented fragrance of that World-Sheltering Beloved.

order.why: Keep the concise declaration of world illumination.
Consider the placeless Orient in relation to the world.
Read the personal invitation toward divine unity.
shortened: O seeker of the lights of Truth! In the Orient of the world, the Sun of the most luminous heaven has risen and illumined the horizon of divine unity.

order.why: Preserve the quoted East–West comparison as source speech.
shortened: Though we are people of the West, yet in intelligence, knowledge, freedom and wisdom we are leaders over the people of the East. If this Most Great Luminary had risen from our horizon, by now the regions of the West would have become the illumined morn, the embodied spirit, and the manifest light."

order.why: Retain the response about worldwide effulgence.
shortened: And if thou asketh about the effulgences of the Sun of Reality, they are radiant upon the horizons of the world.

order.why: Keep the relation between oneness and illumination.
Read the personal invitation to unity and detachment.
Connect the radiance of unity with attachment and harmony.
Receive the declaration of infinite bounty.
Consider rays and waves as evidence of their source.
shortened: The Sun of Truth hath no greater guide than its world-encompassing rays, and the Most Great Ocean no mightier evidence than its sanctified waves.

order.why: Read radiance manifest through different degrees.
shortened: In brief, this praised station is a sun that hath dawned and shone forth in the heaven of prophethood and the firmament of the Cause. Yet its rays and effulgence are manifest in all degrees.

order.why: Keep the account of unveiling in the noble Temple.
Consider generosity made manifest in the sun image.
Read the Day of God within the address to a growing sapling.
Receive the invitation to rejoice in the age of illumination.
Retain the brief testimony to the dawn.
shortened: The Sun of Truth dawned and the light of God appeared.

order.why: Read life breathed into all things through the rays.
Keep the reported statement about the Sun of Reality’s appearance.
shortened: The Blessed Beauty caused the appearance of the Sun of Reality.

order.why: Read belief and the sun’s reflection in its true mirror.
shortened: The Apostle believed in that which was sent down unto him, and likewise the manifestation and effulgence of heat and radiance of the sun in its own true mirror.

order.why: Keep the reported image of Jesus teaching his disciples through rays.
shortened: Jesus was the sun and his rays shone upon his disciples through his teachings.

order.why: Preserve the reported expectation concerning Iran without turning it into a geographical doctrine.
Read the related hope for Persia in its historical setting.
shortened: The Sun of Reality shone forth, casting the effulgences of His Graces upon that country. He proclaimed the Heavenly Teachings and instituted the Religion of the Clement Lord. It is hoped that the Splendor of this Sun might make the expanse of Persia like unto the luminous immensity of heaven.

order.why: Turn description into a prayer not to be deprived of light.
Read the petition for nearness to grace.
shortened: Grant, moreover, that they whose hearts yearn over Thee may draw nigh unto the horizon of Thy grace, above which the Day-Star of Thy beauty sheddeth its radiance.

order.why: Preserve the prayer’s invocation of love, holiness and illumination.
Explains one divine Sun appearing through different mirrors without descending into them.
Keep the brief invocation to the Sun of Reality.
shortened: O Most Glorious Beauty! O Sun of Reality of the Supreme Concourse!

order.why: Retain the prayerful testimony to becoming a lamp.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee for having made me the lamp of the worlds and the light of those who know Thee.

order.why: Receive the hope for a ray upon the heart.
shortened: Therefore I hope that a ray from the Sun of Reality, which hath shone forth from the horizon of manifestation, may fall upon thy heart and that the breathings of the Holy Spirit may quicken thy spirit.

order.why: Keep the servant’s prayer of received guidance.
Read the prayer for souls as clear mirrors.
Ask for attraction, detachment and constancy of direction.
shortened: Say: O God of Names and Creator of Heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Compelling over all things, through which the gate of Thy bounty was opened to all who are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, and the Water of Life flowed forth amongst Thy creatures, to make me attracted to Thy verses, detached from all else but Thee, and in all conditions turned toward the horizon from which shone forth the Sun of Thy Manifestation.

order.why: Keep the particular prayer for a handmaiden’s steps.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy favors which the pens of the world are powerless to recount, and by Thy gifts which the hearts of nations confess are beyond limitation, and by the Light wherewith the Mount was illumined when it shone forth from the horizon of the will of the Lord of Manifestation, to bless the steps of Thy handmaiden whom Thou hast named Neshat-Angiz by Thy wondrous and mighty Pen among Thy chosen ones and loved ones.

order.why: Close this prayer sequence with remembrance in every condition.
Hear the personal call from the horizon of mercy.
Read gratitude as a response to revelation.
shortened: Thus has the Sun of Revelation shone forth from the horizon of grace, that thou mayest give thanks unto thy Lord, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

order.why: Keep the praise of a dawning from loving-kindness.
Connect seeking rays with turning the heart.
Read bounty to the leaves through the image of sunlight.
Consider the measure of sacrifice beside the greatness of bounty.
Turn attention from sedition toward sustaining light.
shortened: O My loved ones! Look not upon the sedition and its darkness, but rather gaze upon the Sun from which nothing has withheld It, and be illumined by Its lights from this Quarter unto which the hearts of those near unto God have been attracted.

order.why: Read longing through snow melting in warmth.
shortened: By God! Wert thou to become aware of its greatness and the greatness of the station of Him Who manifesteth it, thou wouldst melt away with the fire of longing even as snow melteth from the heat of the sun.

order.why: Consider continuing orientation toward the rising sun.
Receive the account of joy at beholding the lights.
shortened: You took the cup of salvation from the hand of the Cup-bearer of the Covenant and became inebriated with supreme joy, delight and longing upon beholding the lights of the Daystar of the horizons.

order.why: Connect trust with the direction of the heart.
shortened: Place thy trust in all matters in Him and turn thy heart toward the holy direction, this Paradise from whose horizon hath shone forth the Sun of Beauty by a command that hath, from time immemorial, encompassed the worlds.

order.why: Keep gratitude for recognition in the personal address.
shortened: O Muhammad-Quli! Praise be to God that thou hast been favored with divine grace and hast recognized the Sun of Truth which hath dawned from the horizon of the heaven of bounty.

order.why: Read greetings intended to convey illumination.
Consider detachment as a ray received by the friends.
shortened: O friends of God! The light of sanctity from the Most Glorious Beauty has shone upon the hearts of the friends and the rays of detachment have dawned.

order.why: Connect rejoicing with the horizon of forgiveness.
Read growth through sun, rain, sea and sheltering tree.
Join illumination with fidelity through trials.
Read gratitude for turning toward understanding.
shortened: O friends of God! Praise be to God that you have been illumined by the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth and have turned your faces toward the Sanctuary of true understanding after the turning away of the peoples of creation.

order.why: Receive the invitation to be illumined.
Keep thankfulness for the Sun of Remembrance.
shortened: Be thou thankful unto thy Lord, inasmuch as the Sun of Remembrance hath shone forth upon thee from this manifest and gleaming horizon.

order.why: Connect the Sun of Utterance with gratitude morning and evening.
Read remembrance from imprisonment as light and water.
Keep the blessing upon fulfillment of the Covenant.
Receive the personal blessing addressed to Nuriyyih.
Move toward becoming a lamp for a gathering.
Connect insight and wisdom with shining forth.
Consider growth and fruit through received radiance.
Join understanding with the demanding work of service.
shortened: O gentle branch! Today's responsibility is mighty - one must gird up the loins of service mightily and advance day by day in the degrees of understanding, so that through the aid and protection of the Self-Subsisting Lord, one may shine forth like a luminous lamp in the glass of contingent being.

order.why: Read the call to kindle guidance and love.
Receive education with gratitude.
shortened: Therefore, praise be to God that you have been brought under the education of this One Who is the very Sun of Reality and Who is shining resplendently upon all humankind, endowing all with a life that is everlasting.

order.why: Read service that helps dispel ignorance.
Keep the hope for a locality to become a dawning-place.
Read the personal call to become lamp, tree, star and pearl.
shortened: O my son! Be a brilliant lamp, a fruitful tree, a radiant star, and a luminous pearl in the shell of possibility, so that the crown of glory may be adorned by your unique gem and pearl.

order.why: Consider two brothers cultivating hearts together.
shortened: When the sun shines in the constellation of Gemini, it forms two seasons - the end of spring and beginning of summer.

I hope that you two brothers will likewise, through the outpourings of the Sun of Truth, adorn the gardens of hearts with the flowers and herbs of divine knowledge, and make the orchard of souls fruitful with the sweet fruits of the love of God.

order.why: Connect radiance with endurance and love.
shortened: O Bayda' Nura'! Bayda' is one of the names of the sun, therefore your radiance and effulgence is the endurance of hardship and tribulation, and the heat of the flame of the love of God. This is the gleaming and brilliance of the sun. This light is eternal and this heat is everlasting.

order.why: Read bounty reaching the weak and poor.
shortened: O thou who gazest toward the Kingdom of Abha! In this Most Great Cycle, when the Sun of Truth hath illumined both East and West, the rays of His bounty have fallen upon the weak and the poor, and through His grace and favor He hath granted them ancient glory, so that His all-encompassing power might become manifest and evident at the world's center like the appearance of the Most Great Luminary.

order.why: Consider the fruit of a soul receiving spiritual light.
Read the reported connection between detachment and inward dawn.
Connect reform with the stated agencies of power.
Read effort opening to confirmation and renewed life.
Consider human realities becoming temples of oneness.
Imagine a gathering reflecting love and unison.
shortened: I hope that assembly, like sparkling stars, may shed the lights of love and unison upon the human world, and become the cause of the happiness and joy of the inhabitants of the earth; that they may become like unto clear mirrors reflecting (the rays) of the Sun of Truth, and give the glad-tidings of the manifestation of the Lord of the Kingdom.

order.why: Test spiritual illumination through mutual service and sacrifice.
shortened: O thou who art firm in the Covenant!

When the Sun of Truth shone forth with intense light and heat from the horizon of the placeless realm upon the world of existence, sanctified souls reached such a station that they sacrificed their lives for one another, arose to serve each other, and became offerings for one another.

order.why: Receive light so as to become a sign of its source.
Consider warmth setting hearts and souls in motion.
shortened: We hope that through the heat of the Sun of Truth which is rising and shining from the horizon of the Unseen, the cold and moisture of hearts and souls will likewise be dispelled, so that sacred realities may be set in motion and, through the heat of that Sun of the heaven of sanctification, may stir in such a way as to bring the world of being into motion and revolution.

order.why: Read the hope for bright candles and pure mirrors.
Let received qualities become visible signs.
Return to pure hearts as mirrors receiving rays.
shortened: This station is like the mighty ocean whose waves strike the shores of contingent realities, and like the most luminous sun whose rays reach the mirrors of pure hearts.

order.why: Read the combined gifts of rain, heat and wind to a growing tree.
Keep the reported appeal to truthful public communication.
Consider knowledge and understanding as guiding lights.
Read the warning against obscuring the lamp through desire.
shortened: O people! This is the lamp of God - extinguish it not with your desires, nor touch it with the evil of your souls, that perchance your misdeeds may be forgiven you on the Day whereon the false ones shall be in loss.

order.why: Return to remembrance, praise and service.
shortened: God willing, in this luminous morn when the world is illumined by the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth, may you be occupied with the remembrance of the Friend, the praise of the Friend, and service to the Friend.

order.why: Retain the brief reported vision of reflected light.
shortened: He was a vision of all divine qualities. In this vision the light of the Sun of Reality was reflected to the world.

order.why: Close with the supplied account of one Primal Will through unending revelations.
shortened: ...the First Remembrance, which is the Primal Will of God, may be likened unto the sun. God hath created Him through the potency of His might, and He hath, from the beginning that hath no beginning, caused Him to be manifested in every Dispensation through the compelling power of His behest, and God will, to the end that knoweth no end, continue to manifest Him according to the good-pleasure of His invincible Purpose. And know thou that He indeed resembleth the sun. Were the risings of the sun to continue till the end that hath no end, yet there hath not been nor ever will be more than one sun.... It is this Primal Will which appeareth resplendent in every Prophet and speaketh forth in every revealed Book.

Hence the inner meaning of the words uttered by the Apostle of God, 'I am all the Prophets', inasmuch as what shineth resplendent in each one of Them hath been and will ever remain one and the same sun....

questions: What does the image of the sun reveal about spiritual education that the images of teacher, physician, or gardener bring out differently?
How do the passages distinguish the source of light from its reflections? What might receiving and reflecting light mean in an ordinary relationship?
What is involved in recognizing the same light from a new horizon? How can attachment, inherited assumptions, or reliance on others affect that recognition?
How do the texts handle the apparent rising and setting of a light described as enduring? What does their use of analogy help explain, and what remains beyond it?
How do the Qur’anic parable and the passage from John connect illumination with guidance and life? What differences in their language invite closer study?
Which passages most clearly connect illumination with conduct, mutual service, or truthful speech? How might you explore that connection in practice?

references.label: 1 · Qur’an 24:35 · The parable of light
references.note: This verse develops an image of light through a niche, lamp, glass, and blessed tree, and connects it with divine guidance. Compare the parallel translations with the passage addressed to Misbah in this compilation. How do several images work together, and why might a text explicitly speak through similitudes?

references.label: 2 · John 8:12 · The light of life
references.note: Jesus describes himself as the light of the world and connects following him with the light of life. Read this verse alongside the compilation’s account of Christ’s perfections and the education of hearts. Consider how the language moves from recognizing a light to following it in one’s life.
